About Us: At Penn Foster Group, we are transforming online learning to help learners by uniting Penn Foster , CareerStep, Ashworth College, James Madison High School, the New York Institute of Photography, the New York Institute of Art and Design, and other education platforms.

Our history dates back to 1890 when our founder, Thomas Foster, pioneered distance education by offering training by mail for coal miners to get the necessary skills for safer jobs.

Today, with the partners who use our education and training programs, we continue that mission of providing accessible training and education for in-demand skills and are building a workforce that’s prepared for the future job market.

Everyone below that line got left with spreadsheets.
We built Precoro for the companies underneath it. A £60m business with four sites gets the control a global one has , live in about three weeks, on the finance system it already runs: Sage, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics or Xero . Spend gets approved against budget before the money moves. Invoices reconcile against orders and receipts on their own. The CFO sees committed spend the day it is committed rather than at month end.

Agents raise and chase POs, route approvals to the right budget holder, read invoices and match them to orders and goods received. Procurement is close to an ideal case for it: the work is high volume, rule bound, and nobody enjoys doing it. Time to value — getting customers to meaningful adoption and depth of use inside what they already own. You drive this; you don't wait for it.

Upsell and cross-sell — expansion within your existing customers: more users, adjacent products, new use cases inside the relationships you already hold.

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers.

Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications.

We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company.

Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem.

We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries.

We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer.

This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward.

If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage.

You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance.

In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

## Ihre Aufgaben ##
Zur Verstärkung unseres Fleet-Teams in Zürich Oerlikon für die Marken Peugeot, Citroën, DS Automobiles, Opel und Leapmotor suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n Key Account Manager/in für die Romandie, wohnhaft in der französischen Schweiz.
* Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und pflegen
* Neukunden-Akquise
* Bedarfsanalyse und Beratung
* Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen und Kostensenkungsmassnahmen im Fuhrparkmanagement
* Eigenverantwortliche Abwicklung sämtlicher verkaufsrelevanter Prozesse
* Koordination zwischen internen Abteilungen: Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb, Marketing, After-Sales und Logistik, um kundenorientierte Lösungen zu veranlassen und umzusetzen
* Sales- und Umsatzverantwortung, sowie Erreichung von Verkaufszielen und KPI's
* Reportings und Analyse
* Marktbeobachtung: Aktives Beobachten von Trends, Aktivitäten der Mitbewerber und Marktbedingungen, um Chancen und Risiken für das Unternehmen frühzeitig zu erkennen
* Mitwirkung/Planung von Marketingaktivitäten und Aktionen zur Kundenbindung und -gewinnung im Bereich Flottenmanagement
## Ihr Profil ##
* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung in den Bereichen Verkauf, Betriebswirtschaft oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Flottengeschäft - vertiefte Kenntnisse im Bereich leichte Nutzfahrzeuge von Vorteil
* B2B-Vertriebserfahrung: Erfahrung im direkten Vertrieb an Unternehmen, insbesondere im Bereich langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen, Vertragsverhandlungen und Flottenmanagement
* Analytische Fähigkeiten, Verhandlungsgeschick sowie Kommunikationsstärke
* Kunden- und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit einer starken Fähigkeit, Kundenbedürfnisse zu erkennen und massgeschneiderte Lösungen anzubieten, die den spezifischen Anforderungen von Flottenkunden gerecht werden
* Eigeninitiative und Selbstorganisation sowie Teamfähigkeit
* Flexibilität und Reisebereitschaft
* Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch und Französisch in Wort und Schrift, Englisch und/oder Italienisch von Vorteil
## Was wir Ihnen bieten ##
Sie finden bei uns eine neue Herausforderung mit spannenden Aufgaben und vielem mehr:
* Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen (Neu- und Gebrauchtwagen, Servicearbeiten und Ersatzteile, Fahrzeug- und Krankenversicherungen, Tankkarten, Hotels und vieles mehr)
* Eine eigene, attraktive Pensionskasse als unabhängige Vorsorgeeinrichtung
* Eine langfristige Unternehmensperspektive
* Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungs-Möglichkeiten
* Mindestens 25 Tage Ferien
## Wie Sie uns kontaktieren können ##
Wir freuen uns auf die vollständige Bewerbung (u.a. Lebenslauf, Arbeitszeugnisse, etc.) via des Links "!". Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird auf die gleichzeitige Verwendung der Sprachformen männlich, weiblich und divers (m/w/d) verzichtet. Weibliche und anderweitige Geschlechteridentitäten werden dabei ausdrücklich mitgemeint.

Diversität bedeutet für uns auch, dass Menschen in Teams zusammenarbeiten, die durch ihre Einzigartigkeit und Unterschiedlichkeit die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse erzielen. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass eine vielfältige Belegschaft, sowie eine integrative Kultur es uns ermöglichen, unser volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen.

Gemeinsam neue Massstäbe setzen und die Zukunft gestalten - das bedeutet für uns mehr, als Aufgaben einfach abzuarbeiten. Hier arbeitest du mit Menschen zusammen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, hohe Ansprüche haben und den Mut mitbringen, neue Wege zu gehen.

Bei uns findest du ein Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen und Leistung Hand in Hand gehen und deine Ideen, deine Initiative und dein Beitrag zählen. So hast du die Möglichkeit, wirklich etwas zu bewegen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden, dein Team und deine persönliche Entwicklung.
## Was du bewirkst ##
* Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines Verkaufsteams mit acht Mitarbeitenden
* Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer Marktbearbeitungsstrategie in der Verkaufsregion Horgen/Knonaueramt in den Bereichen Versicherungen, Vorsorge und Anlagen
* Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung eines bestehenden Kundenstamms in deiner eigenen Verkaufsverantwortung sowie aktive Gewinnung und umfassende Beratung von Privat- und Firmenkunden
* Aufbau und Pflege eines Netzwerks in wirtschaftlichen und gesellschaftlichen Kreisen
* Steigerung der Teamperformance durch gezieltes Coaching, Trainings und individuelle Förderung
* Fundiertes Controlling der Vertriebsaktivitäten sowie Ableitung und Umsetzung konkreter Massnahmen
* Enge, bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zur Verbesserung von Prozessen und Nutzung von Synergien
* Mitgestaltung und Umsetzung regionaler Marketingmassnahmen zur Stärkung der Marktpräsenz
## Was du mitbringst ##
* Mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung als Kundenberaterin oder Kundenberater bei einem Allbranchenversicherer mit nachweisbarem Leistungsausweis
* Höhere Berufsausbildung (z.B. Eidg. Fachausweis, Verkaufsleiter:in, Finanz-, oder Marketingplaner:in)
* Führungserfahrung im Vertrieb oder ausgewiesene Erfahrung in der fachlichen Leitung eines Teams von Vorteil
* Strategisches und analytisches Denken sowie hohe Eigeninitiative und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
* Unternehmerische Denkweise und klare Kundenorientierung

From Fivetran ’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust.

It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About Fyxer
Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.
Far more people start using Fyxer every month than we can speak to. Nobody owns turning those users into paying teams. That's the biggest surface in the company, and it's this seat.

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.
You run the full cycle. First touch, discovery, demo, pricing, close. No handoffs.
You also write the first version of everything: the pitch, the sequences, the objection handling, the qualification bar. None of it exists yet. What you prove out is what the next reps get trained on.

High performer, president club pedigree seller who can name 30+ deals you closed yourself in the last 12 months
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization
You've worked without a playbook, or built one where none existed
Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.
How we work
Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. Everything else is overhead. We automate the research, the notes, the CRM and the follow-up with our own product.
We move fast and decide in the meeting. You own your outcomes. We challenge each other directly. It's intense and it isn't for everyone.
The Fyxer Reality: Why We Win
The Trajectory: We grew from $1M to $30M ARR with a team of just 32.
The Evidence: Ranked 7th in Andreessen Horowitz’s list of top AI apps . Every other company in that top 10 is valued at $10B+. We are the outlier.
The Culture of Agency: We hire exceptional people, give them total ownership, and get out of their way.
Zero Bureaucracy: No slow-motion decision-making. No "alignment" meetings for the sake of it.
This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

We care deeply about providing dignified, redemptive work for people in the Philippines.

This role is critical to our growth strategy: allowing our founder to focus on closing new business while you work on delivery + retention. There will be step-up opportunities to define the function, help close deals, and work cross functionally with our awesome teammates.

Are you client-focused, proactive, and process-driven? Do you enjoy building order, systems, and consistency while managing multiple stakeholders? Recruitment Process Management

Ensure candidate shortlists are delivered, interviews are scheduled, and feedback is collected timely.

Client Success & Retention

Align daily with Recruitment and Operations teams on client priorities and feedback.
Maintain accurate records in Monday.com, Workable, and internal CRM/ATS.
Contribute to refining client-facing SOPs and playbooks.

3+ years of experience in Client Account Management, Recruitment Account Management, or B2B Customer Success.

Experience working with U.S. start ups
Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills (native/bilingual level).
Comfortable using CRM/ATS/Collaboration tools (Workable, Monday.com, Slack, Zoom/Fathom).
Ability to work full U.S. Central or Pacific time zones reliably.
Ability to work reliably and independently in a remote setting with minimal supervision.

Experience managing recruitment pipelines in a remote staffing or BPO environment.
Familiarity with U.S. startup culture, particularly Series B/C companies.

Sales at Uber means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don't come with a script. As a Senior Mid-Market Growth Account Executive, you aren't just managing a portfolio; you are responsible for architecting the growth strategy within it. You will own the most complex, high-potential accounts in Colombia, turning messy business challenges into scalable movement solutions.
This isn't a \"business as usual\" account management role. It is high-stakes, fast-moving, and often ambiguous. You will be expected to move the needle by making hard calls with imperfect information and owning the outcomes. We are looking for someone with a \"go-get-it\" attitude-someone who doesn't wait for a playbook but builds one.

If you thrive on ownership, stay steady under the pressure of tough renewals, and are energized by the challenge of expanding Uber's footprint across massive, complex organizations, this is where you'll make your mark.
This is a hybrid position based in Bogota (3 days/week in the office).

Architect Account Strategy: Own and aggressively grow a portfolio of Uber's most strategically important mid-market accounts, identifying not just the obvious wins, but the complex, high-impact opportunities others miss.
Navigate Complexity: Influence and align multiple senior stakeholders across disparate departments to drive adoption of the full Uber product suite (Eats, Central, Vouchers, etc.).
Lead High-Stakes Negotiations: Drive complex contract renewals and expansions with a value-capture mindset, navigating pricing pushbacks and internal legal/operations hurdles to close deals that scale.
Drive Commercial Excellence: Use data and market expertise to forecast with precision, identify churn risks before they happen, and prioritize your time against the highest-value activities.
Influence Without Authority: Collaborate across Product, Operations, and Marketing to unblock technical barriers and shape the future of the U4B platform based on your clients' real-world feedback.
Solve Through Ambiguity: Adapt your strategy in real-time as market dynamics shift, staying resilient through long deal cycles and the inevitable \"no\" until you find the \"yes\" that creates mutual value.
Raise the Bar: Act as a mentor and \"bar raiser\" for the wider team, sharing best practices in deal-making and account planning to help the entire Colombia hub move faster.

Professional Language Proficiency: Fluent in Spanish and English is mandatory for collaborating with global product and leadership teams.
5+ years of B2B Sales/Account Management experience: Proven track record in a SaaS or high-growth tech environment, specifically managing and growing a revenue quota.
Complex Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated experience navigating and influencing C-level stakeholders within organizations of 1,000+ employees.
Strategic Planning: Proven ability to build, execute, and iterate on multi-quarter territory and account plans.

Systems Thinking: The ability to see the \"big picture\" of a client's business and connect Uber's digital and real-world solutions to their core financial and operational goals.
Data Literacy: Advanced proficiency in Salesforce and data analysis to drive strategic decision-making and identify hidden growth patterns.
Grit and Adaptability: A history of thriving in environments where change is constant and the path to success isn't always linear.
Collaborative Leadership: Experience leading cross-functional projects (e.g., product launches or complex implementations) that required alignment between sales, ops, and tech.
